properties.description: Test pipeline to check PowerShell version on self-hosted IR

scripts.text:
# Check PowerShell Version
Write-Host "=== PowerShell Version Check ==="
Write-Host "PowerShell Version: $($PSVersionTable.PSVersion)"
Write-Host "PowerShell Edition: $($PSVersionTable.PSEdition)"
Write-Host "OS: $($PSVersionTable.OS)"
Write-Host "Platform: $($PSVersionTable.Platform)"

# Check if we can create temp folders
$tempTest = Join-Path $env:TEMP "adf_test_$(Get-Date -Format 'yyyyMMdd_HHmmss')"
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $tempTest -Force | Out-Null
Write-Host "Temp folder creation: SUCCESS ($tempTest)"
Remove-Item -Path $tempTest -Force
Write-Host "Temp folder cleanup: SUCCESS"

# Check available disk space
$drive = Get-PSDrive -Name C
Write-Host "C: Drive Free Space: $([math]::Round($drive.Free / 1GB, 2)) GB"

# Check if Expand-Archive is available (for ZIP extraction)
if (Get-Command Expand-Archive -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) {
    Write-Host "Expand-Archive (ZIP extraction): AVAILABLE"
} else {
    Write-Host "Expand-Archive (ZIP extraction): NOT AVAILABLE"
}

# Check if Get-FileHash is available (for SHA512)
if (Get-Command Get-FileHash -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) {
    Write-Host "Get-FileHash (SHA512): AVAILABLE"
} else {
    Write-Host "Get-FileHash (SHA512): NOT AVAILABLE"
}

Write-Host "=== Test Complete ==="
